decision: Keep coarse ncc_mode 5 and 6 and fine NCC mode 4 as opt-in research options of the frame API. Coarse ncc_mode 6 with fine mode 4 on transfer mode 3 is the recommended CUDA frame setting for research runs (ncc_mode 5 where compute capability is below 8.0, since the Tensor core needs at least 8.0). Defaults, the core and the GUI are unchanged.

hypotheses.H3: held (shallow exhaustive k6/b2 geomean 0.219; pilot 0.129-0.402 on six cases)

failures_and_disclosures.what: first Tensor core data layout was wrong (development, before registration)
failures_and_disclosures.effect: I assumed B's column n was lane & 7; the kernel test failed in mode 6
failures_and_disclosures.fix: a probe (pilot/probe) set single non-zero bytes and derived the layout, all 896 points matched; test kept; mutant L1 added
removed; the tree with tiles is pilot/dev-tree-with-tiles.diff; the cause was not investigated

failures_and_disclosures.what: first two fine screens were not worth keeping (development)
failures_and_disclosures.effect: Src6 subpixel one launch: per-pixel branches 1.40 ms, row-level repair 1.95 ms (about 0.1% of pixels are flagged, so nearly every warp-row was redone), against 1.50 ms for fine mode 2
failures_and_disclosures.fix: pixel-level repair per chunk of 32: 1.21 ms; Nsight outputs kept in pilot/ncu-*

failures_and_disclosures.what: fine mode 4 slowed narrow-ROI images before the width threshold (development)
failures_and_disclosures.effect: pilot subpixel without a threshold: Src4 1.079, Src8 1.058
failures_and_disclosures.fix: FINE_SCREEN_MIN_WIDTH 256 selected on a pilot of widths 0-512; pilot env vars removed before the formal commit

failures_and_disclosures.effect: no test had a score exactly at the threshold
failures_and_disclosures.fix: added the threshold-at-a-score test; L22 killed; L23 and L25 removed before registration as equivalent by construction

failures_and_disclosures.what: data race on the coarseQ28 diagnostic counters (found here, present in the merged kernel modes)
failures_and_disclosures.effect: tid 0 zeroed the block counters while other warps could already add, so a few FP64 tile pixels could be lost from the diagnostic count; outputs not affected; this explains the off-by-one disclosed in CUDA_KERNELS_zh-TW.md
failures_and_disclosures.fix: direct atomicAdd to the global counters, no static shared variables; the count in the kernel test is stable at 23125; the baseline b2 of this report includes the fix, so ratios use the same build

failures_and_disclosures.what: one development build was not recompiled
failures_and_disclosures.effect: after a mutant restore the PC's coarse_cuda.cu was newer than the unpacked Mac copy, so ninja kept the old kernel and I still saw the counter jitter
failures_and_disclosures.fix: rebuilt; the formal run used a fresh git archive and a fresh build directory, so it was not affected

failures_and_disclosures.effect: the waiting script polled formal.log every 60 s until timing-start appeared, so it read it once within 60 s after timing began (round 0 of the standard run, warm-up, not in the summary); then every 20 minutes and once after the end; each poll read the whole formal.log (under 400 bytes), as the protocol says; no other connection to the PC during timing
Src1 shallow k6 in after.bat reported Connection to Agent lost and produced no data; the empty files stay in profile/
failures_and_disclosures.fix: rerun once by hand with the same arguments into profile/retry after the mutants; profiling only, not a formal timing

failures_and_disclosures.what: Src3, Src8, Src9 and FastMode Src2 did not get faster
failures_and_disclosures.effect: up to 2.1% slower on the standard set; H1 measures the geometric mean, so this is no gate failure; the cause was not profiled

failures_and_disclosures.what: f4 alone has almost no benefit in default and FastMode
failures_and_disclosures.effect: geomean 0.994 and 1.005; the gain is in subpixel on images with wide ROIs (Src6 0.815, Src1 0.931, Src2 0.932, Src7 0.952)

failures_and_disclosures.what: mutants U1, U2, U5, U7, U8, U9 survive
failures_and_disclosures.effect: report-only by protocol; U7 needs a template over 66051 pixels and a bright image, U8 only computes windows that are never scored, U9 only protects a few bytes of over-read on sources under 2 px

failures_and_disclosures.what: the fine search Tensor core was not tried
failures_and_disclosures.effect: the user asked about Src6 subpixel fine search; only an estimate from SASS exists: at most about 10% of the instructions, and occupancy (33%, Nsight's bound 66%) looks like the better next step

failures_and_disclosures.what: the coarse result buffer is sized for the worst case
failures_and_disclosures.effect: shallow Src1 peak RSS 2152 MiB and 2.1 GB of device bytes in every arm, one 16-byte entry per window; this design predates the round
failures_and_disclosures.fix: disclosed as a limit; not changed
